releaseNotes:
• Official Release v1.1.4 (Build 15)
• Real camera capture with secure FileProvider, camera permission check, and preview before send (Retake, Cancel, Send)
• Real video sharing with video picker, duration & size extraction, and preview dialog
• Real full-screen video player using Android Media3 ExoPlayer with Play/Pause, scrubbable seekbar, elapsed/duration time, mute toggle, buffering spinner, error retry, and save to Movies/Netchat
• Media gallery download saving photos to Pictures/Netchat and videos to Movies/Netchat
• Profile photo management with photo picker, camera capture, full-screen viewer, and removal with fallback to account letter initial
• Non-destructive SQLite schema v11 database migration
